summary: Manulife Financial filed a Form 6-K with a news release announcing it will not redeem its Series 3 or Series 4 Class 1 Preferred Shares, triggering conversion privileges for holders on June 19, 2026. The conversion is one-for-one between series, subject to minimum-outstanding conditions (1,000,000 shares) that could force automatic conversion. Dividend rates for the next reset periods will be set on May 21, 2026. This is a routine preferred-share conversion notice, not a special situation event. It involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
